scripts.build: next build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const out='out'; const needed=['index.html','about.html','work.html','contact.html']; const missing=needed.filter(f=>!fs.existsSync(path.join(out,f))); if(missing.length){ console.error('Missing export files:', missing.join(', ')); process.exit(1);} console.log('Static export OK:', needed.join(', '));"
